caption: A first-person view shows a person floating on their back in a turquoise natural pool. The camera holder's legs, clad in patterned pink and blue swimwear, drift and kick gently near the surface. Another person's bare foot and leg float to the left, swaying with the water. A raised right arm wearing a gold watch occupies the right side of the view. It gradually slides toward the top edge as the viewpoint tilts forward. Once the arm leaves view, the scene centers on the visible legs and the open water ahead, where small ripples and splashes spread around the moving limbs. Behind them, a rocky bank lined with lush green ferns rises toward a wooden deck with railings. Some chairs sit along the deck, while the floating and gentle leg movement continue steadily.
